entries.reason: Delete removes the row it is pressed on (by its stable id). v5 removed the stored entry at the shown position, so with deadlines entered out of date order Delete on the first shown (earliest) deadline removed the first-entered one instead.
entries.author: CC-07 worker (GRS-17)

entries.reason: After that delete, v5's calendar still holds the deadline the user deleted and lacks the one v5 removed by mistake; the app's calendar holds the deadlines the table shows.
entries.author: CC-07 worker (GRS-17)

entries.reason: Each calendar event's UID is the deadline's stable row id, so it never changes when other deadlines are deleted and a calendar re-import updates the same event; v5's UID was the deadline's storage position (S-deadlines_tab-2, S-ics).
entries.author: CC-07 worker (GRS-17)

entries.reason: Each calendar event carries the DTSTAMP property RFC 5545 requires, stamped from the clock; v5 omitted it (S-deadlines_tab-2, S-ics).
entries.author: CC-07 worker (GRS-17)

entries.reason: Commas, semicolons and backslashes in a deadline's title and note are escaped as RFC 5545 text, so the calendar shows them as typed; v5 replaced commas and semicolons with spaces and left backslashes unescaped (S-deadlines_tab-2, S-ics).
